text: CAPE is about 41, the second-highest reading on record and close to the 2000 peak.

2026 capex guidance is about $720-745B across Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta, roughly 38% of combined revenue (MLQ). To meet full-year targets, Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta must raise quarterly spending 25-51% above Q2 levels in the second half.
Debt now funds about 32% of hyperscaler capex, up from 9%. $220B of bonds were issued by Aug 10 versus about $70B in all of 2025, and 78 of 91 are trading above issue yield.
Anthropic targets a roughly $2T IPO on a $65B run rate (about 31x). Its prospectus shows a $518B infrastructure plan and nearly a quarter of revenue from two unnamed customers.
Top-10 stocks are about 41% of the S&P 500 versus about 23% at end-2000, and cap-weight has beaten equal-weight by about 32% over three years, matching the late-1990s gap.

OpenAI reported a $38.5B net loss on $13.07B revenue in 2025. A secondary source (Luminix) also cites projections of about $14B net loss in 2026 and $278B cumulative negative free cash flow through 2030; these conflict with the reported 2025 figure and are unconfirmed.
Nvidia Q2 FY27 revenue was $96.2B (+106%) at 75% gross margin with $21.3B of free cash flow. Counterpoint: its customers are the ones spending the capex, so this overlaps with the capex rows.

Lab run rates are growing faster than capex: Anthropic from $9B at end-2025 to $65B in July, OpenAI to about $70B in September, against capex growth near 80%. Run rate can overstate recognized revenue.
Anthropic reported positive adjusted operating income in Q2 2026. This is adjusted, and its 2025 GAAP net loss was $42B.
Leading-edge compute is scarce: Blackwell supply is reserved into 2027 and CoWoS is sold out, which is the opposite of the idle-capacity pattern in a glut.
Cloud growth was accelerating as of Q1 2026 results: Google Cloud +63% and AWS +28%, the fastest in 15 quarters. Q2 figures were not checked.
Credit markets are repricing, not panicking: hyperscaler spreads are only about 10bp wider than 2025.
